title: Public payments under deals and laws in force, and the years they run

rows.clause: Full property-tax exemption since 1982 (Real Property Tax Law section 429) for as long as both an NBA and an NHL team play their home games there, with no sunset; the Department of Finance values it at $43.3M in fiscal 2026
rows.label: b

rows.what: 0.5% city sales tax for the Delta Center deal
rows.clause: 30-year non-relocation commitment tied to Salt Lake City's 0.5% sales tax from 2025 (about 2054-55)
rows.label: b/c

rows.what: Rental-car tax for the renovation bonds
rows.clause: City $142.5M = $110M of bonds backed by the existing rental-car tax, which the Legislature extended from 2038 to 2047 (House Bill 937, signed May 3, 2016)
rows.label: c

rows.clause: operating expense reimbursements (approximately $12,500,000 in year one with a 4.6% increase after six years)
rows.label: b

rows.what: County payments to the arena operator
rows.clause: County payments of $6.4M a year through fiscal 2029 (FY2026 budget), $1.5M in fiscal 2030, then $8.5M a year to June 2035, under the 2014 agreements; either side may end them from July 2035
rows.label: b

rows.clause: a city finance memo puts Target Center debt service at about $53.5M for 2026-2035
rows.label: c

rows.what: Major capital repairs the lease leaves to the public
rows.clause: Gateway still responsible for Major Capital Repairs (audits); its board has told the city and county it lacks the funds (Resolution 2025-4, which gives no date for the notice); press reports the lease covers capital repairs totaling more than $500,000 (Ideastream, 2019) and more than $400 million of repairs needed at the arena and ballpark through 2037 (Ideastream, 2026)
rows.label: b/c

rows.clause: city+county pay $4.95M/yr for four seasons from 2021-22, then $6.3M/yr for four seasons
rows.label: c

rows.clause: The state must keep paying $3.65M a year, a Quality Jobs equivalent, through FY2029
rows.label: b

note: Entered by hand from each agreement, audit, budget or report named in its sources (data/authorities/payment_terms.csv); amounts as the documents state them, in the dollars of their day. A blank end year means the payment has no end date.
method: select p.team, p.what, cast(p.start_year as integer) as "start", try_cast(p.end_year as integer) as "end", p.amount, p.decided, p.approved, p.clause, p.label, coalesce((select list(s.source_id order by s.ord) from term_sources s where s.team = p.team and s.what = p.what), []) as sources from payment_terms p order by coalesce(try_cast(p.end_year as integer), 9999) desc, p.team
